thread:
alex: Heads-up — multiple customers in APAC reporting timeouts and huge latency, looks like requests are getting routed to US-hosted pools instead of the APAC dedicated clusters. Billing spike too. Anyone else seeing this?

maria: seeing same from telemetry — jump in cross-region p95 and routed_requests_hosted metric up x6 since ~09:12 UTC.

jamal: getting 503s for some requests, sample request_id `r-0a9b1c2d`. Auth logs show token intact. Error snippet: 
```
HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable
X-Request-Id: r-0a9b1c2d
error: pool_unavailable
```

li: ops-bot posted an alert at 09:14, looks like routing agent falling back because dedicated pool reported degraded capacity. But the fallback is sending to hosted in a different region (us-west) instead of closest hosted mirror in apac-sg.

ops-bot: alert: routing-fallback-triggered cluster=apac-dedicated-34 cause=eviction_score_high fallback_target=hosted-us-west count=320

alex: This is bad — customers expect traffic to stay in-apac for latency and compliance. Need quick repro and a mitigation path.

maria: repro steps so far: 1) send burst of 1000 concurrent small requests pinned to tenant T-543 on apac-dedicated; 2) trigger transient eviction (simulate GPU OOM); 3) routing controller sets fallback policy; 4) traffic lands in hosted-us-west.

jamal: config excerpt from tenant routing: `preferred_region: apac; fallback_policy: nearby_then_hosted; affinity_ttl: 60s` — nearby_then_hosted should pick hosted-apac mirror, not us-west. Something mapping nearby->us-west for that tenant.

li: hypothesis: topology service returned stale region mapping for the tenant (edge-case during deployment), so routing agent thought apac mirror was offline and selected default hosted region (us-west). Checking topology history now.

ben: quick mitigation: can we flip tenant-level override to force hosted-apac or disable fallback to hosted entirely for affected tenants? That should stop cross-region landing while we root-cause.

maria: we can patch override via admin API: `POST /admin/tenants/T-543/overrides {"fallback_target":"hosted-apac"}` — applied for T-543 and confirmed acceptance. Watch metrics.

ops-bot: config-change recorded user=infra-batch action=tenant-override tenant=T-543 change=fallback_target->hosted-apac

alex: after override, latency improved for T-543 but other tenants still show spillover. Need a global guard until topology service fix.

jamal: rolling a temporary guard in routing controller to prefer same-region hosted mirror if fallback_target is hosted and region mismatch detected. I'll push a canary in staging then prod if green.

li: found the root cause: topology service returned `region_groups` for apac incorrectly during a schema migration — apac mirror flagged as draining for ~6m causing controller to skip it. The migration rolled back but routing controller cache TTL (120s) and affinity TTL kept misrouting traffic for longer.

maria: follow-ups: 1) reduce routing cache TTL from 120s->30s for next deploy, 2) add guard to prefer hosted mirror in same region even if flagged draining for <60s, 3) audit tenant-level routing history for chargeback.

ben: finance note — billing team flagged two customers for unusual hosted spend; need list of impacted tenants + timestamps to reverse anomalies or apply credits. I'll coordinate.

alex: thanks team. Jamal/ Li — please coordinate the patch + deploy and post rollback plan in this thread. Maria/Ben — prepare customer comms and billing mitigation. I'll loop in infra PM to follow-up on topology migration safeguards. :thumbsup:

jamal: creating PR and will tag @alex @li for review. Rolling canary in 10m.

li: will keep monitoring — sending dashboard link: https://internal.redwood/dashboards/routing/apac-fallback (check hosted-routed-by-tenant panel)

maria: starting templated customer update: "We observed transient cross-region routing that impacted latency and costs. We've applied tenant-level overrides and deployed routing guard to ensure traffic remains within APAC-hosted mirrors. We're investigating root cause and will apply credits where appropriate."

ops-bot: incident note created: INC-2026-0789 severity=high owners=[jamal,li,maria]

alex: Excellent. Keep this thread updated with timestamps of fixes and any customers that need manual credits.
